claim: Let \(D=G(10,3)\) be the Desargues graph, with vertices \(u_i,v_i\) for \(i\in\mathbb Z/10\mathbb Z\) and edges \(u_i u_{i+1}\), \(u_i v_i\), and \(v_i v_{i+3}\). Its independence complex satisfies \(\operatorname{Ind}(D)\simeq S^4\vee\bigvee^5 S^5\).
integrity: The homotopy equivalence is proved by an exhaustive finite acyclic matching plus exact signed Morse-boundary computation; mod-2 homology is an independent consistency check, not a substitute for the attaching-map argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the Desargues graph, not all generalized Petersen graphs.
The literature comparison cannot exclude an obscure or unindexed duplicate.
No independent audit has been performed.
title: Independence complex of the Desargues graph is \(S^4\vee\bigvee^5 S^5\)
